title: Vygotsky Distance: Measure for Benchmark Task Similarity
reasoning: The paper uses the term "Vygotsky distance" named after psychologist Lev Vygotsky's "zone of proximal development". This is a metaphorical reference to a psychological concept to define a task similarity metric, not an evaluation or benchmarking of religion, morals, or ethics. The paper focuses on technical aspects of NLP benchmark analysis and compression.
